Follow-on to dispatch-speed (merge 0c853d542). Its evidence page is docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/dispatch-speed.html, and its review record is ~/.config/reckon/crew/reviews/reckon/r-20261003T114532582934-dispatch-speed.json. Read both first.
1. The input build before the pick bound still has a median of 1.642 s (p90 1.767 s) against the 1.0 s target, dominated by decoding full picker records. Measure it in a fresh process for project reckon, cold and after appending a run file. Cut it to a median at or below 1.0 s without changing any picker input: for example, persist the projected fields the picker reads alongside the index, so full payloads are never decoded on the dispatch path. Equivalence against an uncached full build must hold after appending and after editing a run file; prove it with tests.
2. Close the three review follow-ons:
 (a) routing.py, around line 3152: the estimate-cache stamp filters by location, while resolve_resource matches by content type, so a plan resolved from a non-plan typed root is missing from the stamp. Stamp what resolve_resource actually reads.
 (b) ledger.py, around line 738: _file_identity catches only FileNotFoundError, so a stat PermissionError raises out of shared_verdict_inputs. Restore the old contract: any OSError forfeits the cache and never raises.
 (c) lane_context.py, around line 257: _ledger_stamp now stats every run file, so the profile-cache key is O(runs). Make it constant-cost again, reusing the index's own change marker.
Add a test for each of (a), (b) and (c).
3. Record the before and after figures, from tool output, in docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/dispatch-speed-followups.html.

Gate: tests/test_dispatch_speed.py, tests/test_picker*.py, tests/test_run_time_profile.py, tests/test_ledger*.py, tests/test_budget*.py, tests/test_capabilities.py and tests/test_crew_runs_by_run_id.py. Run them with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 in the FOREGROUND, with one log for base and one for head under the run directory, each ending in an EXIT line, judged by delta. Do not edit reckon/crew/dispatch.py outside the picker-input functions. The coordinator runs the whole-suite measure at merge.
